text:
Gold Price in 1975
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1975, the LBMA gold price fell 20.2% between 1975-01-31 ($176) and 1975-12-31 ($140). The highest sampled price was $182 in February and the lowest was $138 in November. The mean of these observations was $160. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
